title: The assistant hands every member without the app to WhatsApp for offers, with no way to leave out someone who asked not to be messaged
what: When the owner asks for a come-back offer, a 'we miss you' message or a festival wish, the assistant lists every member in that group who lacks the app and offers to send it to each of them on WhatsApp. There is no 'does not want messages' mark on a member anywhere, so a member who told the gym to stop still lands on the list, and the assistant's own ideas keep suggesting win-back offers to lapsed members. WhatsApp's rules ask senders to message only people who agreed and to honour a request to stop; members who report the owner's number can get it limited or blocked.
expected: A member can be marked 'no offers on WhatsApp' and the assistant leaves them out of offer and win-back lists (and says how many it left out); greetings and gym-closed notices can still go.
who: owners and members who asked to stop
how_often: every offer or win-back sent to members without the app
fix_line: Add a no-offers mark on a member and drop marked members from offer lists

title: The AI that writes offers to members is not told to avoid promising body results
what: The rules given to the AI that drafts and rewrites member messages forbid inventing phone numbers, links, prices and dates, but say nothing about health or body-result promises. An offer draft can come back saying things like 'lose 5 kg in a month' or 'guaranteed results', which India's advertising code (ASCI) treats as claims that need proof. The owner can edit the draft, but nothing warns him.
expected: The writing rules also say: never promise weight loss, body changes, health cures or guaranteed results.
how_often: sometimes, when the AI adds a claim
fix_line: Add one line to both writing rules banning result and health promises

items.reason: the AI Assistant lives in the admin web app at app.mettleup.fit; it ships in no iPhone or Play store app, and buying credits is not built in the panel
no pictures, clips, music or voices shipped here; the four icons are simple hand-drawn shapes (not copied from an icon set); fonts come from the shared kit (Google Fonts, open licence)
